title: Building the Cross-Chain Economy with CCIP | Lido at SmartCon 2025
description:
At SmartCon 2025, Lido’s Master of DeFi, Jakov Buratović, explains how Chainlink CCIP enables fast and low-cost transfers, cross-chain DeFi access for its users, and a frictionless user experience without compromising on security. 

View the SmartCon 2025 playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVP9aGDn-X0R1kuQo8qLPnqlT7ThKQR2s 

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. 

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

✅ Subscribe and turn notifications on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnjkrlqaWEBSnKZQ71gdyFA?sub_confirmation=1

Learn more about Chainlink:

Website: https://chain.link
Docs: https://docs.chain.link
Twitter: https://twitter.com/chainlink

#Chainlink #crypto #blockchain

asr.full_text: hello everyone thank you for having me today I'll be talking about building the cross-chain economy where Lido meets ChainLinks CCIP so first of all this is me I'm a contributor to Lido and I'm a master of DeFi so what is that, it's a fancy name for someone who's trying to create as much utility as possible for LIDO staked assets, namely RepState and StakedEth, but at the same time make these assets more accessible. What does that mean? Part of the story is network expansions. If you see a new L2 or L1 popping up, obviously it will be super interesting for users, so you want to make sure that users can use your assets on those networks. So before going to what is new, what is cool, let's repeat where we are today and what we've built so far. So ethereum staking is natively available only on Ethereum mainnet. That's a fact! We cannot really change it, at least not super easy. So naturally, Lido's RAP stat, is natively available on Ethereum mainnet where it finds its home. However, L2's are not a new thing. A couple of years ago, they started popping up and becoming really important part of Ethereum ecosystem, which, naturally, gave us a signal, hey, we have to do something to ensure that users can use Rep-Stat on these other networks. So intuitively we wanted to stay obsessed with security and go with the super... A simple and secure approach. And we started using network's native bridges or canonical bridges to bridge Rep-Stat. Currently LIDAR Rep-Stat is available officially on 15 networks, even more with permissionless deployments, but these 15 have officially been processed, so we can call it like that. This approach is, as I said, very secure, but very slow at the same time. Also, if you have your rev stat on a network K, say Arbitrum, and you want to bring it to network B, say Optimism or BASE or whatever, there is really not a simple or fast way to do it right now. So basically you have two options. First one, try to do it using one of the third-party liquidity bridges, which are essentially cross-chained DEXs, rely on local liquidity on both chains. So you can do this kind of cross chain swap if there is enough liquidity on both of these networks, depending on the sides, you will be facing some slippage and so on. If you're talking about a new network pair, most likely is gonna be like impossible. So option B, go back to Ethereum mainnet, withdraw, wait wait sometimes for days if you're talking about optimistic rollups potentially miss out, all of the opportunity that you wanted to capture on network B once the withdrawal matures go and bridge to Network B so it works it can be much better that's the point of the story so what to do about it well create official partnership with Chainlink It can be much better. That's the point of the story. So what to do about it? Well, create official partnership with Chainlink where we are introducing burn and mint for Lido Repstat using CCIP infrastructure. It's a big step ahead. And what is actually it bringing and what does it actually mean in practice? It means that now we can do fast transfers incise. The same example that I gave before, you have some tokens on Arbitrum, and you want to bridge it to any network, even a new one, will be going through CCIP, which means that tokens get burned on network A, message get sent using CCIP. Once it's received on the network B, the token is natively minted, which means there is zero reliance on secondary liquidity. It's kind of great and it's standardized. It's using a unified lockbox on Ethereum Mainnet. What is that enabling aside of transfers for retail for large and small token holders? It is making Rep RepStat ready for cross-chain DeFi. And I think this is something that is becoming increasingly more important. We are seeing many protocols that's originated on the Ethereum mainnet appearing on manual tools, and they're trying to leverage these cross chain features. So RepStat is ready for that. One good example that we have is a vault that we spun up with collaboration with Feda, it's called GGV vault. It is a super cool omni-chain vault which means that users are able to deposit ETH or Repstat or Staked ETH on Ethereum mainnet, but these tokens that are inside can be allocated by a curator on many other networks to capture opportunities basically anywhere inside the ecosystem. Imagine now you as a curator operator of this omni-chain vault, you allocate three million dollars worth of Reptat to network A and suddenly on this network A, the opportunity is not good anymore, and at the same time, you found a good opportunity on network B. What do you do? If you have to withdraw and wait seven days, miss out on all of the rewards and then potentially miss out the opportunity on network B... it's very frictionate. Of course, if you're getting more inflows, you can work around it, but it's's not great but if you can burn these tokens and mint it in a couple of minutes or a couple of seconds and the network B it's kinda great it's not only great for curator it's also great for the users of these of this world because they will have a better market efficiency ultimately it will face a higher rewards product. This is just one example but it is important as well, and what does this upgrade mean? This means that we keep the best UX. We are even upgrading the user experience with these crossing chain transfers that was not possible before but without increasing you know like trust assumptions without like hurting the security aspect of the whole thing. The system is super super robust there are many limitations for like higher amounts of transfers to make sure that the whole system stays very robust and one really really important thing for all of the users, this is not minting a new Repstat v2 or something like that, this is a direct upgrade of the existing token, which means that for users for holders, for protocols, this will be going super seamless. You don't have to do anything, the whole upgrade process will be happening in different phases, so there are already a couple of networks where Vrbstat is available, using the latest CCIP deployment, the current, existing, ones those 15 that I mentioned will be upgraded in phases using DAO vote. So once again, this is super exciting for me. I think this is opening up a lot of great opportunities for builders and for users and to sum it all up, just let's go onwards from here, thank you.
